have h1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (t * x)) := by continuity
have h2 : MeasureTheory.AEMeasurable (fun ω => t * X ω) μ := by aesimp [mul_right_continuous]
have h3 : MeasureTheory.AEMeasurable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
  by { refine MeasureTheory.ae_measurable.comp _ h2, exact h1 }
exact h3
